data.title: add_research — append a structured research item
data.summary: MCP tool _add_research(project, slug, item, expected_version). Required fields: id, type, title, source, added_by, when. Validates then appends to data.research via append_to_list.

sections.body: Add _add_research(project, slug, item, expected_version) to reckon/mcp.py. Validate required = {'id','type','title','source','added_by','when'}; if missing return {ok:False, error: 'missing fields: ...'}. Call append_to_list(project, slug, 'research', item, expected_version). Valid type values: paper|doc|web|dataset|thread|image|plan. Add AddResearchArgs to reckon/_mcp_tools.py with item described as dict[str, Any] with field description listing required and optional keys.

In tests/test_mcp_tools.py: test_add_research_success (item appended, version bumped), test_add_research_missing_fields (ok=False; error lists the missing fields), test_add_research_conflict (stale version returns conflict response).
